description: F5: a `struct` type name colliding with the Geometry overlay primitive `measure` raises `ol-reserved-word` at phase-1 registration. Issue #403. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why only one report survives and it reads `stage: "semantic"`.

diagnostics.message: measure is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
